# Nayu Technologies Inc.
> Canadian IT Consulting, Staff Augmentation, Contract Resource Management, and Payroll Administration Partner.

## Overview
Nayu Technologies Inc. is an Ontario-based IT consulting and workforce solutions company serving organizations across Canada and North America. We combine practitioner-led technical screening with end-to-end contract resource management and compliant Canadian payroll administration.

## Core Services
- **IT Staff Augmentation & Sourcing:** Contract, contract-to-hire, and direct placement for Cloud Architects, Software Engineers, DevOps/SREs, Data/AI Specialists, and Agile Delivery Leaders—technically vetted against real enterprise engineering standards.
- **Contract Resource Management:** Full contingent workforce lifecycle management including onboarding, NDAs, compliance verification, timesheet governance, and consultant retention support.
- **Payroll & Contractor Administration:** Compliant Canadian payrolling for T4 and incorporated (Corp-to-Corp) IT contractors, statutory deductions, and consolidated client invoicing.

## Practice Areas
- Cloud, Infrastructure & DevOps (AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Terraform, CI/CD)
- Application, API & Core Engineering (Java/Spring Boot, .NET, Python, Node.js, Kong/Apigee, Microservices, Kafka)
- Enterprise AI, Data & Automation (Applied AI/ML, LLM & RAG Development, Data Engineering, SQL/NoSQL)
- Agile Delivery, QA & Domain Specialists (Technical Project Managers, Scrum Masters, Business Systems Analysts, QA Automation, Banking & Insurance Consultants)
